entries.title: Exodus 39:1
segments: ¶Of the blue, purple, and scarlet [thread] they made garments of ministry, for ministering in the holy [place], and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:2
segments: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], and of fine woven linen.

entries.title: Exodus 39:3
segments: And they beat the gold into thin sheets and cut [it into] threads, to work [it] in [with] the blue, purple, and scarlet [thread] and the fine linen, [into] artistic designs.

entries.title: Exodus 39:4
segments: They made shoulder straps for it to couple [it] together; it was coupled together at its two edges.

entries.title: Exodus 39:5
segments: And the intricately woven band of his ephod that [was] on it [was] of the same workmanship, [woven of] gold, blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], and of fine woven linen, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:6
segments: And they set onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold; they were engraved, as signets are engraved, with the names of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 39:7
segments: He put them on the shoulders of the ephod [as] memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:8
segments: And he made the breastplate, artistically woven like the workmanship of the ephod, of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], and of fine woven linen.

entries.title: Exodus 39:9
segments: They made the breastplate square by doubling it; a span [was] its length and a span its width when doubled.

entries.title: Exodus 39:10
segments: And they set in it four rows of stones: a row with a sardius, a topaz, and an emerald was the first row;

entries.title: Exodus 39:11
segments: the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;

entries.title: Exodus 39:12
segments: the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

entries.title: Exodus 39:13
segments: the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. [They were] enclosed in settings of gold in their mountings.

entries.title: Exodus 39:14
segments: [There were] twelve stones according to the names of the sons of Israel: according to their names, [engraved like] a signet, each one with its own name according to the twelve tribes.

entries.title: Exodus 39:15
segments: And they made chains for the breastplate at the ends, like braided cords of pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 39:16
segments: They also made two settings of gold and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

entries.title: Exodus 39:17
segments: And they put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

entries.title: Exodus 39:18
segments: The two ends of the two braided chains they fastened in the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in the front.

entries.title: Exodus 39:19
segments: And they made two rings of gold and put [them] on the two ends of the breastplate, on the edge of it, which [was] on the inward side of the ephod.

entries.title: Exodus 39:20
segments: They made two [other] gold rings and put them on the two shoulder straps, underneath the ephod toward its front, right at the seam above the intricately woven band of the ephod.

entries.title: Exodus 39:21
segments: And they bound the breastplate by means of its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord, so that it would be above the intricately woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate would not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:22
segments: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

entries.title: Exodus 39:23
segments: And [there was] an opening in the middle of the robe, like the opening in a coat of mail, [with] a woven binding all around the opening, so that it would not tear.

entries.title: Exodus 39:24
segments: They made on the hem of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet, and of fine woven [linen].

entries.title: Exodus 39:25
segments: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates on the hem of the robe all around between the pomegranates:

entries.title: Exodus 39:26
segments: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, all around the hem of the robe to minister in, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:27
segments: They made tunics, artistically woven of fine linen, for Aaron and his sons,

entries.title: Exodus 39:28
segments: a turban of fine linen, exquisite hats of fine linen, short trousers of fine woven linen,

entries.title: Exodus 39:29
segments: and a sash of fine woven linen with blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], made by a weaver, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:30
segments: Then they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription [like] the engraving of a signet: HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 39:31
segments: And they tied to it a blue cord, to fasten [it] above on the turban, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:32
segments: ¶Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was finished. And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses; so they did.

entries.title: Exodus 39:33
segments: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its furnishings: its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

entries.title: Exodus 39:34
segments: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of badger skins, and the veil of the covering;

entries.title: Exodus 39:35
segments: the ark of the Testimony with its poles, and the mercy seat;

entries.title: Exodus 39:36
segments: the table, all its utensils, and the showbread;

entries.title: Exodus 39:37
segments: the pure [gold] lampstand with its lamps (the lamps set in order), all its utensils, and the oil for light;

entries.title: Exodus 39:38
segments: the gold altar, the anointing oil, and the sweet incense; the screen for the tabernacle door;

entries.title: Exodus 39:39
segments: the bronze altar, its grate of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils; the laver with its base;

entries.title: Exodus 39:40
segments: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its sockets, the screen for the court gate, its cords, and its pegs; all the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;

entries.title: Exodus 39:41
segments: and the garments of ministry, to minister in the holy [place]: the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister as priests.

entries.title: Exodus 39:42
segments: According to all that the LORD had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

entries.title: Exodus 39:43
segments: Then Moses looked over all the work, and indeed they had done it; as the LORD had commanded, just so they had done it. And Moses blessed them.
